subject: AcreetionOS Update — July 06, 2026
body:
The AcreetionOS continuous integration pipeline has just been refined with the introduction of per-pipeline staging directories, significantly enhancing the reliability of our ISO build process by avoiding publish races between concurrent builds. This improvement is a direct result of our community's efforts to ensure a seamless and stable experience for users, and you can find more details about these changes on our changelog page at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html.

Development
The recent updates to our CI pipeline are part of our ongoing commitment to improving the quality and stability of AcreetionOS, and we're excited to see the impact of these changes on our users. With the use of relative symlinks for the latest.iso file, we're making it easier for users to access the latest version of our distribution. For more information on how to get started with AcreetionOS, check out our documentation at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html.

Community
Our community has been buzzing with the news of Emacs 31.1 release, and we're seeing a lot of interest in how this update will integrate with our Arch-based distribution. As always, our community is at the forefront of discussing and implementing these updates, and we encourage all users to participate in the conversation. You can find more information about our community efforts and how to get involved on our wiki at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html. If you're looking for the latest news and updates, be sure to check out our flash page at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html for the most up-to-date information.
